abstract: Among 15 patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors experienced during the past 12 years, 5 were diagnosed with germ cell tumors with somatic-type malignancy. The pretreatment stages were stage I in 2 patients and stage II in 3. All 5 patients received perioperative chemotherapy plus surgical resection, and 4 remain alive without relapse, with a mean follow-up of 60 months.
abstract_ja: 過去12年間に治療した原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍15例のうち、体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う胚細胞腫瘍5例を報告する。病期は病期I 2例、病期II 3例であった。全例が周術期化学療法と外科的切除を受けた。平均60か月の追跡で、5例中4例が再発なく生存している。
